native.ow_rise_us: Actual released line threshold-crossing bound under all topology/loading conditions.
native.ow_fall_us: Actual driven-low threshold-crossing bound; software delay is not proof of edge.
native.ow_data_slots: Actual data bits transferred for selected byte stream, excludes reset/ROM/search unless explicitly accounted.

native.ow_age_ms: Actual correlatedsampleage, independent presence or transferCRC.

native.ow_overdrive_transition: Actual standardreset plus overdriveROM command and speed-switch sequence completed.
native.ow_open_drain: Actual bus wired-AND open-drain interface, not push-pull driving high.
native.ow_presence: Actual resetpresence observation; not functional acceptance.
native.ow_short: ActualDS2482 shortdetected status, not assumedfalse from validsource.
